data.one_liner: iOS implementation of the google_maps_flutter plugin.
data.what_it_does: Provides the default iOS platform implementation for the google_maps_flutter plugin, rendering Google Maps natively on iOS devices. It uses Google Maps SDK 8.4, 9.x, or 10.x depending on the minimum deployment target.
use_when: You are using google_maps_flutter and need the default iOS implementation.
You are maintaining an existing project that targets iOS versions below 15 or 16 and uses CocoaPods.
avoid_when: You want to use Swift Package Manager, as this package does not support it.
You need ongoing feature updates, because this package is deprecated for new features.
You are building for iOS 15+ or 16+ and can use the updated SDK-specific implementation packages.
strengths: Maintains compatibility with previous versions of the google_maps_flutter plugin via endorsed federated setup.
Supports a range of Google Maps SDK versions (8.4, 9.x, 10.x).
weaknesses: Will not receive new feature updates going forward.
Does not support Swift Package Manager.
Lacks support for certain features like GoogleMap.onPointOfInterestTap.
data.setup_notes: Specify your API key in the application delegate ios/Runner/AppDelegate.swift using GMSServices.provideAPIKey.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a customizable, open-source map solution using Leaflet without native Google Maps dependency constraints.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: The parent federated package which automatically manages this and other platform implementations.
